claims.evidence: Photos 0-2 show wooden pallets with standard slat construction on concrete and stacked indoors in a warehouse or storage area.

risks.risk: Exact dimensions (length, width, height) are unknown
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure or ruler placed alongside the pallet showing all three dimensions
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-standard or unknown size pallet

risks.risk: Load capacity or weight rating is unknown
risks.proof: Close-up of any load rating marking, stamp, or structural marking on the pallet
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown or light-duty capacity

risks.risk: Treatment type (heat-treated or chemically treated) is unknown
risks.proof: Close-up of the IPPC or HT stamp or other treatment marking on the wood
risks.if_unproven: Priced as untreated or unknown treatment

risks.risk: Condition details such as rot, cracks, or insect damage are not shown
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the top slats, bottom boards, blocks, and nail or fastener areas
risks.if_unproven: Priced as damaged or poor condition

risks.risk: Total quantity available is not shown
risks.proof: Wide shot or video panning across all pallet stacks with a visible count
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a single pallet or unknown lot size

risks.risk: Age or prior usage history is unknown
risks.proof: Close-up of wear patterns, seller-provided usage history, or dated markings
risks.if_unproven: Priced as heavily used or unknown age

proof_requests: Close-up of IPPC or treatment stamp
Photo with tape measure showing length, width, and height
Close-up of slats, blocks, and fasteners for rot, cracks, or insect damage
Wide shot or video showing total quantity of pallets
Any visible load capacity marking or stamp
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as wooden pallets in standard slat construction in a storage setting, so a worst-case price is possible; missing specifics are treated as risks to be resolved by proof requests.
